tagline: Draw along with a little buddy.
sub: A friendly buddy shows how to draw, one step at a time, and cheers every finished picture.
note: No ads. No accounts. No network. Buy once, on Mac, iPhone and iPad.

sections.p: Follow the dotted line, tap the rings, colour in the shapes. The buddy says each step aloud and celebrates with one to three stars. Scoring never says "wrong": a wobbly line still counts.

Pick any lesson or one of 12 scenes, from a sunny village to a space trip, and its fine dotted lines appear on your page. Use every tool, colour and zoom. A little finished picture floats beside the page to peek at.

sections.h: A box of real art tools
sections.p: Crayon, marker, paint brush, glitter and six sticker shapes. A rainbow of colours and a colour mixer: tap two or more colours and watch them blend. Undo and redo everything, erase only the ink you touch, and move, resize, turn, recolour or copy any drawing.

Choose a built-in buddy, draw one, or turn a photo into a buddy. Squiggo lifts the subject off its background right on your device. Add googly eyes, a mouth, eyebrows, hair and glasses, choose how it moves, and give it a name it will say out loud.
Finished pictures go up on a wall with pins and stars. Open one, swipe to the next, or copy it to keep painting.
Every tap bounces and plays a gentle sound. Pick one of six styles or switch them off. The buddy reads each step aloud, and one switch turns the voice off.

privacy.pHtml: No ads, no accounts, no tracking and no network access at all. Pictures stay on your device unless a grown-up shares one. Squiggo never asks for your photo library: the system picker shares only the one picture you choose. The full privacy policy says the same in more detail.

mac.p: Draw with the mouse or trackpad, pinch to zoom, use the keyboard shortcuts, and drag a picture in from the Finder. Also on iPhone and iPad.

requires: Requires an iPhone or iPad with iOS 17 or later, or a Mac with macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Android tablets are coming.
